|{3: }{4:○ }{5:bold}{4: two}|
|{6:  }{7:✸ }{8:bold}{7: three}|
|{9:   }{10:✿ }{11:italic}{10: and }{12:bold}{10: four}|
|{13:    }{14:◉ }{15:under}{14: }{16:verbatim}{14: }{17:code}{14: }{18:strike}{14: five}|
|Body with {19:bold}, {20:italic} and {21:verbatim}.|

{1} OrgHeadlineLevel1 -> Title [bold]
{2} OrgHeadlineLevel1 -> Title | OrgBold [bold]
{3} OrgHeadlineLevel2 -> Constant | OrgHiddenStars -> Conceal
{4} OrgHeadlineLevel2 -> Constant
{5} OrgHeadlineLevel2 -> Constant | OrgBold [bold]
{6} OrgHeadlineLevel3 -> Identifier | OrgHiddenStars -> Conceal
{7} OrgHeadlineLevel3 -> Identifier
{8} OrgHeadlineLevel3 -> Identifier | OrgBold [bold]
{9} OrgHeadlineLevel4 -> Statement | OrgHiddenStars -> Conceal [bold]
{10} OrgHeadlineLevel4 -> Statement [bold]
{11} OrgHeadlineLevel4 -> Statement | OrgItalic [bold, italic]
{12} OrgHeadlineLevel4 -> Statement | OrgBold [bold]
{13} OrgHeadlineLevel5 -> PreProc | OrgHiddenStars -> Conceal
{14} OrgHeadlineLevel5 -> PreProc
{15} OrgHeadlineLevel5 -> PreProc | OrgUnderline [underline]
{16} OrgHeadlineLevel5 -> PreProc | OrgVerbatim -> String
{17} OrgHeadlineLevel5 -> PreProc | OrgCode -> String
{18} OrgHeadlineLevel5 -> PreProc | OrgStrikethrough [strikethrough]
{19} OrgBold [bold]
{20} OrgItalic [italic]
{21} OrgVerbatim -> String
